title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
description: Apollo 11 (July 16–24, 1969) was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon.

title: Launch of Sputnik 1
description: Earth's first artificial satellite was a polished metal ball about the size of a beach ball that pretty much just orbited and beeped. But radio operators around the world could hear that beep, and it kicked off the Space Race.

title: Yuri Gagarin's flight into space
phrase: Yuri Gagarin becoming the first person in space
description: Vostok 1 made a single orbit of Earth in 108 minutes. Gagarin didn't land with his capsule: he ejected about 7 km up and parachuted down on his own!

title: Launch of Voyager 2
description: Despite the name, Voyager 2 launched first. It's still the only spacecraft to have visited Uranus and Neptune.

title: Launch of Voyager 1
description: Launched sixteen days after its twin on a faster path, Voyager 1 is the most distant human-made object. It carries a golden record of sounds and music from Earth.

title: First Space Shuttle launch
description: STS-1 sent Columbia into orbit twenty years to the day after Yuri Gagarin's flight. It was the first time Americans had flown in space since 1975.

title: Space Shuttle Challenger disaster
description: Challenger broke apart 73 seconds after launch, killing all seven crew members. An O-ring seal in one of the solid rocket boosters failed in the unusually cold weather. The Challenger disaster is still a foundational case study of engineering safety, group communication, and management.

title: Launch of the Hubble Space Telescope
phrase: the launch of the Hubble Space Telescope
description: Hubble's first images were blurry because its main mirror had been ground to slightly the wrong shape. A 1993 shuttle mission fitted it with corrective optics. I always thought it was cool that a telescope had to get glasses.

title: Mars Pathfinder landing
description: Pathfinder bounced onto Mars wrapped in airbags, then let out Sojourner, the first rover to drive on another planet.

title: First crew arrives at the International Space Station
phrase: the first crew arriving at the International Space Station
description: Expedition 1 started a continuous human presence in space that hasn't been broken since.

title: Curiosity rover lands on Mars
phrase: the Curiosity rover landing on Mars
description: Curiosity was too heavy for the bounce down on airbags approach, so NASA lowered it to the surface on cables from a rocket-powered sky crane. The engineers called the landing "seven minutes of terror."

title: New Horizons flies past Pluto
description: New Horizons launched in January 2006, when Pluto was still a planet, and took nine and a half years to get there.

title: Launch of the James Webb Space Telescope
phrase: the launch of the James Webb Space Telescope
description: Launched on Christmas morning, folded origami-style to fit inside its rocket. On the way out to its orbit a million miles from Earth, it had to unfold a sunshield the size of a tennis court and it worked perfectly.
